# Your Brain on Social Media

> Evidence-based resource hub helping parents, educators, and teens understand social media's impact on adolescent brain development and mental health.

Your Brain on Social Media provides comprehensive research, practical toolkits, and expert guidance on digital wellness for families and schools. The site combines neuroscience research with actionable strategies for managing teen social media use and building healthy digital citizenship.

## Key Topics

- Teen Mental Health
- Social Media Effects
- Digital Wellness
- Parental Controls
- Screen Time Management
- School Phone Policies
- Digital Media Literacy
- Cyberbullying Prevention
- TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat
- Parent-Child Communication
- Child Safety
- Social Media Addiction
- Brain Development
- The STUDY Act
- Digital Citizenship

## Core Resources

- [Home - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org): Homepage introducing social media impacts on teen mental health and digital wellness.
- [Resources - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/resources): Curated library of research and guides on social media effects and digital wellness.
- [About - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/about): Mission and background of Your Brain on Social Media organization.

## Parent Guides & Family Resources

- [What Now? Experts Inspired Parent Playbook - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/resources/experts-inspired-parent-playbook): Expert-backed parent guide for managing screen time and family media plans.
- [How To Talk To Your Kids About Social Media - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/resources/how-to-talk-to-your-kids-about-social-media): Video series and guide for parent-child conversations about social media.
- [FAQs + Top Recommendations - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/resources/faqs-top-recommendations): Expert FAQs and recommendations for managing teen social media use.
- [App Features + Controls - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/resources/app-features-controls): Parent guide to Instagram, Snapchat parental controls and safety features.
- [Know the Risks - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/resources/know-the-risks): Comprehensive guide to social media risks including privacy, content, and challenges.

## School Implementation & Policy

- [School Resources - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/school-resources): School leadership toolkit for cell phone policies and media literacy education.
- [Cell Phone + Device Policies - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/policies): Sample cell phone policies from Worcester Public Schools and Mount Greylock.
- [Implementation Resources - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/implementation): Practical guidance for schools implementing phone policies with student support.
- [Digital Media Literacy - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/digital-media-literacy): Curriculum guide for teaching digital media literacy and responsibility.
- [Community Norms - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/community-norms): Framework for establishing digital citizenship and healthy technology norms.

## Research & Science

- [The Science - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/the-science): Research library on teen brain development and social media effects.
- [Social Media + Mental Health - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/resources/social-media-mental-health): Research overview on social media effects on adolescent mental health and anxiety.
- [Top Concerns - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/top-concerns): Guide to key social media risks including cyberbullying, FOMO, and algorithms.

## Legislation & Advocacy

- [Lawsuits + Legislation - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/lawsuits-legislation): Overview of social media litigation and The STUDY Act legislation.
- [Social Media in the News - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/news/social-media): News coverage and updates on social media impacts and platform accountability.

## Optional

- [Contact - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/contact): Contact form for inquiries and messages to the organization.
- [Press Resources - Your Brain on Social Media](https://www.yourbrainonsocialmedia.org/news/press-resources): Press kit and media contact information for journalists and media outlets.
